eventLedger.freezeStatement: Event membership, public-source dates and direction labels were fixed before the source researcher inspected any stock prices or returns. No stock prices or returns were accessed by the source researcher.
eventLedger.selectionRule: NG/Donlin and NAK/Pebble, 2020-01-01 through 2025-12-31; dated primary-source material permitting and regulatory proposals/final actions or actual court/administrative rulings. Exclude financing, earnings, exploration, ownership changes, lobbying, lawsuits merely filed and duplicate coverage.
eventLedger.publicationDatePolicy: Conservative date of the directly verified public primary-source announcement; retain earlier action date separately. Earliest dissemination is not proven. Null timestamps explicitly indicate no verified intraday time.
eventLedger.sourceMethod: Bounded issuer archive and official agency/court-source search. All qualifying, sufficiently dated events located in this pass retained without viewing prices. Original court publication dates were not inferred from later financial reports.
coverageLimitations: This is a bounded, incomplete source sample, not a comprehensive event census.
Nine Pebble events and three Donlin events are heavily concentrated in two issuers.
Procedural admissions, environmental review completion, proposed restrictions and final decisions differ in materiality; direction is a coarse document-effect code.
All timestamps are date-only; several announcements lag actions and may lag first public awareness.
Donlin adverse and mixed rulings were located in later reports but excluded where contemporaneous qualifying publication could not be verified. This can create direction and source-availability bias.
Publication dates identify documented availability, not surprise, investor knowledge, or market reaction.
Issuer and government releases have interested-party framing; direction rationales use procedural effect rather than their promotional claims.

prices.adjustmentVerificationBasis: Vendor adjusted-close field is present in all four snapshots; its dividend/split meaning is verified against Yahoo Help. This is not an independent exchange-price audit.
limitations: Current-vintage vendor history may contain later corrections; no archived as-of vintage is claimed.
GLD is a traded gold ETF proxy, not spot gold or a Tok mineral-interest price.
Adjusted closes are total-return comparison inputs, not literal executable fill quotes.
No missing price is forward-filled. The hypothetical closing-entry policy assumes access to a closing execution.
Penny-stock prices may have limited vendor precision. Some NAK evaluation windows are flat at the supplied precision; those zeros are not independently verified at finer precision.

SPY.name: State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust

events.title: Donlin receives state pipeline and transportation authorizations
events.rationale: Final state land authorizations remove specified infrastructure permitting barriers; they do not authorize all construction.
events.sourcePublisher: NOVAGOLD, issuer release archived by SEC
events.sourceEvidence: Issuer reports final pipeline right-of-way authorization on January 17 and transportation-related authorizations on January 2.
events.dateNotes: Use the dated February 6 issuer announcement, not the earlier agency action dates. Earlier public agency availability was not established.

events.title: USACE publishes final Pebble environmental impact statement
events.rationale: Completion advances environmental review, but the agency explicitly withholds a permit decision. Net project effect is coded uncertain.
events.sourcePublisher: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Alaska District
events.sourceEvidence: Final EIS was publicly released July 24. Permit authorization remained a separate later decision.

events.title: Army finds proposed Pebble project cannot receive a permit
events.rationale: Agency finds significant adverse impacts and inadequate mitigation, creating a direct barrier to permitting the submitted plan.
events.sourceEvidence: Army states the submitted project cannot be permitted under Clean Water Act section 404 because of environmental impacts and inadequate mitigation.

events.title: USACE denies Pebble permit application
events.rationale: The formal denial blocks the submitted project from obtaining its required federal permit.
events.sourceEvidence: Dated issuer announcement reports receiving formal USACE notification that its federal permit application was denied that day.

events.title: USACE accepts administrative appeal of Pebble denial
events.rationale: Agency acceptance opens review of the denial. This is a favourable procedural ruling, not a reversal or permit grant.
events.sourceEvidence: A February 24 USACE letter found the appeal request complete and eligible; the issuer announced this February 25.
events.dateNotes: Later verified issuer publication used instead of the letter date.

events.title: EPA proposes restrictions on Pebble-related discharges
events.rationale: The revised proposal would prohibit or restrict discharges needed for the project if finalized, increasing regulatory obstacles.
events.sourceEvidence: EPA opened a revised section 404(c) proposed determination for public review on May 25.
events.dateNotes: Use press release date; later Federal Register notice is not an independent event.

events.title: EPA regional recommendation advances Pebble discharge restrictions
events.rationale: The regional recommendation advances restrictions to headquarters review. Final determination was still pending.
events.sourcePublisher: Northern Dynasty Minerals, corroborated by EPA
events.sourceEvidence: The issuer published its response December 2. EPA records identify the December 1 recommendation and subsequent headquarters consultation.
events.dateNotes: December 2 is the verified contemporaneous public issuer response, not a claim of first dissemination. The issuer calls it a veto, but EPA records distinguish recommendation from final action.

events.title: EPA finalizes Pebble discharge prohibitions and restrictions
events.rationale: Final section 404(c) restrictions prevent the submitted development from using specified waters for mine waste discharges.
events.sourceEvidence: EPA describes final prohibitions for the submitted mine plan and restrictions on future proposals with similar or greater impacts.
events.dateNotes: Final-determination page dates issuance January 30. Announcement page is dated by January 31 update and corroborated by same-day issuer archive. Use January 31 conservatively.

events.title: USACE remands Pebble denial for reconsideration
events.rationale: Successful appeal grounds reopen specified issues in the denial, while the separate EPA restriction remains in force.
events.sourceEvidence: Issuer says the Pacific Ocean Division did not sustain the denial and returned specified issues to the Alaska District.
events.dateNotes: Issuer release April 26 describes an April 25 announcement. Use later directly verified publication date; do not assume a trading time for April 25.

events.title: USACE declines Pebble remand work while EPA restriction stands
events.rationale: The agency declines to reconsider the denial while the EPA restriction remains, closing the immediate administrative route.
events.sourceEvidence: Issuer reports USACE declined remand proceedings because of the intervening EPA restriction; decision was without prejudice.
events.dateNotes: Contemporaneous issuer announcement says today; separate underlying document signature date was not independently verified.

events.title: Donlin receives FAST-41 federal permitting coordination coverage
events.rationale: Formal coverage adds coordinated federal review and public timelines. It does not remove requirements or approve construction.
events.sourceEvidence: Agency announced coverage October 27 for the supplemental environmental review following the court remand.
events.dateNotes: The current dashboard records an October 24 project posting. Because that historical page state and coverage status were not archived here, use the explicit October 27 agency announcement; earlier public awareness is possible.

events.title: Alaska Supreme Court upholds Donlin state water and pipeline permits
events.rationale: The court rejects constitutional challenges and sustains the specified state approvals, reducing that legal obstacle.
events.sourceEvidence: State legal department reports the November 14 ruling upheld water appropriation permits and the state-land pipeline right-of-way.
events.dateNotes: Use the verified November 18 government release. Court decision was November 14 and may have been public then; exact earlier publication was not established.

Current-vintage adjusted prices lack historical as-of vintages. Adjusted closes are not literal executable fills; the delayed-close policy is hypothetical.
GLD is a traded gold ETF, not spot gold. Stock-minus-benchmark returns are observed diagnostics, not forecasts or a replicated hedge.
Favourable events alone enter the long-only diagnostic; adverse/mixed events hold cash. Costs are an assumed stress, not measured execution.
